description: Flavor text templates for CSI Lab scene. Real clue phrasing is generated from gameState.identityEvidence (attribute + thief_value). Red herring clues are cosmetic only - they never map to any suspect attribute.

real_clue_templates.hair_color: Lab found a single {value} hair fiber caught on the display case latch.
real_clue_templates.blood_type: A small blood smear on broken glass tested as type {value}.
real_clue_templates.biological_sex: Voice stress analysis on the alarm override call indicates a {value} speaker.
real_clue_templates.shoe_size_category: A partial shoe print near the service door suggests a {value}-sized shoe.
real_clue_templates.race: DNA trace analysis on skin cells recovered from the frame indicates {value} ethnicity.

red_herring_pool.label: A fiber from a wool coat
red_herring_pool.flavor_text: Lab identified a wool fiber near the entrance - could belong to half the winter coats in the city.

red_herring_pool.label: An old coin
red_herring_pool.flavor_text: A tarnished coin was found under the display case, dated decades before the theft - probably dropped long ago.

red_herring_pool.label: A cigarette butt
red_herring_pool.flavor_text: A cigarette butt near the fire exit - no DNA match on file, likely unrelated to the crime.

red_herring_pool.label: A torn receipt
red_herring_pool.flavor_text: A torn café receipt found in the hallway, printed the same week - could be anyone's.

red_herring_pool.label: A stray hair (non-matching color)
red_herring_pool.flavor_text: A second hair strand was found, but its color doesn't match the primary sample - inconclusive.

red_herring_pool.label: A smudged handprint
red_herring_pool.flavor_text: A handprint on the window was too smudged to extract usable ridge detail.

ui_flow.step_1: Player enters CSILabScene after completing the Hidden-Object crime scene.
ui_flow.step_2: CSI officer dialogue plays, revealing lab results one by one.
ui_flow.step_3: Real clue is shown using real_clue_templates[gameState.identityEvidence.attribute] filled with gameState.identityEvidence.thief_value.
ui_flow.step_4: 2 random red herrings from red_herring_pool are shown alongside, same visual weight as the real clue.
ui_flow.step_5: All 3 clues are stored in gameState.csiClues; only the real one has isReal:true (hidden from player, used later for elimination logic).
ui_flow.step_6: Player proceeds to Suspect Board scene, where the real clue's attribute becomes the elimination filter.
